generatedCommentsNodes.comment: In `merge`, the call to `other.checkInvariant(bucket)` uses the destination bucket index instead of the source bucket index (`otherBucket`). It should be `other.checkInvariant(otherBucket)`.

review_comment: I yanked this out because it looked like it'd be safe to share at least a little code. I didn't plug this into the `X-BucketedSort` classes yet. But I think it's just about the same thing.
I yanked the bytes behavior to a common class. It's tiny, but feels like it saves a bit of copy and paste and the compiler will tell you the variant bits.
